questions.questionText: hour Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, highlighters, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are thirty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet.

options.A: increased preference on the part of consumers for distinctive non-standardised products

questions.questionText: The demand for a firm’s product is perfectly elastic. What will be the effect on the firm’s revenue if it increases its price by 5%?

options.C: Its revenue will fall to zero.

questions.questionText: What is most likely to occur when a command economy makes the transition towards becoming a market economy?

options.A: an increase in unemployment in the short run
options.B: a slower response to changes in technology
options.C: a decrease in the production of consumer goods
options.D: a decrease in the productivity of workers

questions.questionText: Which combination is usually found in developing countries?

options.A: a high birth rate and a dominant primary sector
options.B: capital intensive production and a low rate of saving
options.C: labour intensive production and a declining population
options.D: net inward migration and a low death rate

options.B: There has been a decrease in the level of output.
options.C: There has been a decrease in the velocity of circulation.

options.A: the change in average living standards

What will result from rising unemployment in an economy?

options.A: a reduction in the government’s budget deficit
options.D: the economy’s production possibility curve will move inwards

questions.questionText: Why is a high ratio of government debt to GDP likely to cause a decline in a country’s economic growth?

options.A: Higher taxes to pay the interest charges on the debt will reduce the country’s money supply.
options.B: It will cause the growth in actual output to fall behind the country’s long-term rate of growth.
options.C: It will increase the cost of borrowing to both the government and the private sector.
options.D: It will weaken the country’s competitiveness by increasing unit labour costs.

questions.questionText: Which policy would be most likely to improve a country’s prospects of achieving a higher long-run rate of growth?

options.A: an increase in the government’s budget deficit
options.B: an increase in tuition fees charged to university students
options.C: intervention in the foreign exchange market to raise the exchange rate
options.D: the introduction of tax incentives to encourage households to save more

questions.questionText: What is most likely to result from foreign direct investment in developing economies?

options.A: a deterioration in the trade balances of developing economies
options.B: a reduction in migration to urban areas
options.C: a reduction in the transfer of technology to developing economies
options.D: a rise in per capita levels of consumption in developing economies
